classification.difficultyReason: Subtract two triangular areas from the enclosing rectangle to find the parallelogram's area.

content.prompt: Rectangle $ABCD$ has length $8$ cm and height $4$ cm.

spec.description: Rectangle ABCD, with X on AB near A and Y on DC near C. Segments DX and BY bound the light-blue central parallelogram DXBY; triangles AXD and BYC are unfilled. Source blue outlines are rendered black under house style.
spec.mathematics: AB=DC=8 cm, AD=BC=4 cm, AX=YC=2 cm. DXBY is the region remaining after removing triangles AXD and BYC.
spec.answerVisibility: All geometry and region shading are permanent givens; no calculated areas are shown.

children.prompt: The two triangles $AXD$ and $BYC$ have height $4$ cm and base $2$ cm. Find the area of the parallelogram $DXBY$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}
\text{Area of rectangle }ABCD&=8\times4\\
\text{Area of rectangle }ABCD&=32\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}
\text{Area of each triangle}&=\tfrac12\times2\times4\\
\text{Area of each triangle}&=4\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
Subtract both triangles from the rectangle.
$$\begin{align*}
\text{Area of }DXBY&=32-2\times4\\
\text{Area of }DXBY&=24\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
